title: Schedule B (Interest and Ordinary Dividends): required when taxable interest or ordinary dividends exceed $1,500 (ADR-0036 decisions 1-4). Part I/II itemization rows come only from collect_members over the same closed families lines 2b/3b already collected; Part I ties to the box-1 (1099-INT) family only, which is the family this milestone's fixtures ever populate for interest - a scope-bounded simplification (see rule.form1040-line2b.json's four-subtotal composition for the full interest surface), never silent about it. Part II ties to the box-1a (1099-DIV ordinary) family, a 1:1 match with line 3b. Part III completeness is presence-semantics only: a yes on foreign-account (7a) adds the 7b country requirement and names the FinCEN-114 obligation (never produced); ADR-0036 ratifies no distinct obligation for foreign-trust (8), so no branch_requirements entry names one for it.

names_obligations.label: Foreign Bank Account Report (FinCEN Form 114 / FBAR) obligation named; this product never produces FinCEN-114 content or a filing artifact of any kind.
